title: Packager
description: Adds a new craftable moving box item that allows for moving any block from one place to another in survival, regardless of nbt or other conditions.
body:
This datapack introduces a new craftable item to move blocks around called the **MOVING BOX**.

![Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/95bf6e5232ccf1879cab6555cd44ec8784edf17b.png)

The item can be crafted in a crafting table as show in the image above. With this item, even in **survival**, you can move any placed block in your world from one place to another. 

Some good examples are chests and mob spawners, but the possibilities are endless. Anything from just a piece of dirt, to a budding amethyst, without forgetting warden spawning sculk shriekers! CAREFUL!!

Thanks for enjoying the datapack and I am always happy to answer to comments or issues.
